brz_guard.text: Good day. Champion, is it? You're on the list. The RAF Police checked you at the Cotswolds gap, and I trust their judgement more than my own.
The terminal is straight down the road, on your right. Mind the apron. Aircraft always have right of way, and some of them don't have a driver.

brz_spotter_chat.text: I can tell a Voyager from an Atlas by the sound alone. The Atlas is a rumble. The Voyager is a polite whistle.
They say that if you stand here with a flask and a notebook you can write down forty tail numbers an hour. That's the dream, anyway.

brz_vicar.text: St Britius is the church in the village, and the RAF has its own chapel, but the village takes the Sunday bell for itself.
At Christmas, the aircraft come in over the church tower. It's said that this is how the angels' flight path was planned.

brz_pjt.text: I teach people to fall out of aeroplanes and arrive in one piece. It is just the second half that's hard.
We jump from the Atlas here. The trick is to be afraid for the first three seconds and have a splendid time for the next three minutes.

brize_norton_bureau.text: Welcome to the bureau de change. Local money in, sterling out, or the other way round. A small fee, and a very small queue.
